video_backlog.title: Ep 7: Why AlphaFold's ipTM Rejects Real Microprotein Tethers (ipSAE & 5x5 MiniPAE)
video_backlog.layer_name: Layer 21: Directional ipSAE & 5x5 MiniPAE Co-Folding Confidence Gate
video_backlog.bio_problem: Whole-chain ipTM averages error over flexible disordered linker tails (crushing an 0.45 A 10-aa SLiM inside an 80-aa microprotein to 0.1250), while single-contact random coils fool simple distance checks.
video_backlog.cs_mechanism: Restrict Dunbrack's d0(N_i) length scale strictly to contacts with PAE < 10 A (rescuing ipSAE to 0.8315), require a contiguous 5x5 diagonal MiniPAE window (0.475 A vs 25.08 A decoy), and store sparse contacts in a 1,090-byte zero-TOAST PGPA CSR container with 16B O(1) header peeking.
video_backlog.speedup_metric: +0.7065 IDR rescue (ipTM 0.1250 -> ipSAE 0.8315) + 194.13x smaller inline CSR (26,316 complexes/sec/core)
